_comment: Source failure test. Twitter URL as resolution source. Expected: critical source_failure finding.
question: Will Elon Musk tweet about Dogecoin before December 31, 2025?
resolution_criteria: This market resolves YES if the Twitter/X account @elonmusk publishes any tweet or post containing the word 'Dogecoin' or the ticker 'DOGE' before December 31, 2025.
known_vulnerabilities: Twitter.com URL requires authentication to view — may not be accessible to all resolvers
Tweets can be deleted after posting — no archival requirement specified
Twitter/X has changed its URL structure multiple times
Account could be suspended, restricted, or renamed
No definition of what counts as a 'tweet' vs a 'reply' vs a 'retweet'
